title: TRUE GROUND
logSummary: Benchmark 1 re-surveyed under the Instruments' eyes, the line off Ninewalls' walls, and calima at noon.

stages.note: Follow the Scar's line to Benchmark 1
stages.log: Walked the Scar's line to Benchmark 1.

stages.note: Re-survey Benchmark 1: hold the Alidade, take bearings  {n} / {of}
Watch the line leave Ninewalls' walls
stages.log: The line faded off Ninewalls' walls.

stages.note: Kindle the Brazier at the Ninewalls cistern and rest
stages.log: Rested at the Ninewalls cistern until noon.

stages.note: Cross to the Malpaís edge under the calima
stages.log: Crossed to the Malpaís edge in the calima.

stages.note: Read what walks on the rim
stages.log: Read the Transit: baseline, station 1 of 9.

closing.logEnd: Ninewalls is true ground. The Transit is walking its baseline.

resurvey.about: The re-survey's overlay: the three marks' pips under the arc, by mark id (src/game/quest/scar-plan.js RESURVEY.marks).

breaAlone.about: Brea's own turns in the field on 'True Ground': one card each, shown as a subtitle when its trigger first happens. Each trigger shows once. The bearing turns are filled with the bearing she took.

lines: Two of them, coming to look.
Keep the glass on the mark.
Hit. The arc holds where it was.
Off the mark. Back on it.
Ninewalls is where it says it is.
Nine walls, and not a mark
of vermilion on one of them.
